post.title: Post to Linear
post.description: Creates a new Linear issue for branch <mono>{{branch}}</mono> and attaches the conversation as JSON + a summary comment. To post back into an existing issue, start the worktree from the Linear panel (bottom-left) — picking an issue there seeds the session and routes the post-back to that issue automatically.
post.looksLikeIssue: Looks like an issue id. Start the worktree from the Linear panel (bottom-left) to seed it with that issue — the worktree menu will then offer a direct "Post conversation to {{issue}}" action.
post.invalidTeamKey: Expected a team key like ENG (uppercase letters only).
